> **Common Commands**
>
> * SSH tunnel:
>
>   ```bash
>   ssh -L 8080:remote:80 user@remote
>   ```
> * WireGuard:
>
>   ```bash
>   sudo wg-quick up wg0
>   sudo wg show
>   ```
> * OpenVPN:
>
>   ```bash
>   sudo openvpn --config client.ovpn
>   ```
